_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative lifecycle, imperative allocation (a split over posted lines and participant shares)
_meta.description: The joint arrangement allocation run (GRAllocationRun: propose, confirm, invoice), the customer a participant is invoiced as, and the run a contribution invoice came from. The split and the invoices live in lib/Service/PublicSector/JointArrangementAllocation.php.

GRAllocationRun.title: GR allocation run
GRAllocationRun.description: The costs posted on a joint arrangement allocation key's cost clusters over a period, split over the active participants by share. One line per participant; the lines add up to the total to the cent. A confirmed run is locked and can invoice each participant with a draft contribution invoice.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The administration of the joint arrangement whose posted lines are split.

keyId.title: Allocation key
keyId.description: The allocation key whose cost clusters are split.

keyName.title: Key name
keyName.description: The allocation key's name, as shown on the run.

periodFrom.title: Period from
periodFrom.description: The first day of the period, inclusive.

periodTo.title: Period to
periodTo.description: The last day of the period, inclusive.

name.title: Name
name.description: The run's name: the key and the period.

total.title: Total
total.description: The costs posted on the key's cost clusters in the period, in euros.

lines.title: Participants
lines.description: One line per active participant with its share and amount.

participantName.title: Participant
participantName.description: The participant's name, as shown on the run.

share.title: Share
share.description: The participant's share of the total, between 0 and 1.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The participant's part of the total, in euros.

invoiceId.title: Invoice
invoiceId.description: The draft contribution invoice written for this line.

invoiceDate.title: Invoice date
invoiceDate.description: The date of the contribution invoices; today when empty.

paymentTermDays.title: Payment term (days)
paymentTermDays.description: Days between the invoice date and the due date.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: The run has a key and a period; its lines can be proposed and proposed again.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: The lines are locked. No other run for the same key and period can be proposed or confirmed.

invoiced.label: Invoiced
invoiced.description: Every participant line has a draft contribution invoice.

propose.label: Propose
propose.description: Sum the costs posted on the key's cost clusters in the period and split them over the active participants by share.

actions.description: Fill the lines and the total.

confirm.label: Confirm
confirm.description: Lock the lines of the run.

actions.description: Refuse an empty run and a second run for the same key and period.

invoice.label: Invoice participants
invoice.description: Write one draft contribution invoice per participant line, naming the run.

actions.description: Write the draft invoices and keep their ids on the lines.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Who proposed, confirmed and invoiced the run, and when.

customerId.title: Customer
customerId.description: The customer this participant is invoiced as for its contributions.

allocationRunId.title: Allocation run
allocationRunId.description: The joint arrangement allocation run this contribution invoice was written for.
